satyr_john 41m Replying to @mykingdom_identity51 Yes, all of them are in the same location. The same sequences of viral DNA, in the same place, for species which we already know are related through other lines of evidence. No such sequences in species which are known to part of different descent trees. The sequences are known to be transmitted to offspring with no selection pressure, because they are non-coding. The history which ERVs record is virtually identical to a map of descent relationships established by other means. 1
